conclusion: Shared broad 2D anime treatment: crisp contours, rich colors and angular cel shading. Some World Games examples have stronger highlights. The successful #135 retry used the earlier Saiyan artwork as its style reference.

135_review.composition: Krillin in the left-center foreground looking back, Android 18 and Piccolo behind facing away, young Goten waving at right; user clarified the identity after the first retry.
135_review.expression: Krillin retains a gentle closed-mouth smile and backward glance.
135_review.hands_and_edges: Goten has child proportions, navy long undersleeves, a cheerful youthful face and a connected five-finger waving hand. The scene is continuous; original fine details obscured by stages remain unresolved.
135_review.background: Blue sky, soft white clouds and greenery; no blank strips or hard internal division.
135_review.native_ui: Existing V3 frame, title geometry, category, Level/PUR, stages, rules and footer retained.

mastery126: Successful retry includes young Goten at right and the other four original group members. The earlier Saiyan artwork supplied its rendering style. Fine footwear details remain uncertain.
